svg.aria-label: One-shot code sandboxes: one claimed microVM per run
svg.title: One-shot code sandboxes: one claimed microVM per run
svg.text: One-shot code sandboxes: one claimed microVM per run
Every entry point reaches one sandbox service; it records the sandbox before booting it, claims it with a one-time nonce, and never invokes an id that is not running
Sandbox subnets: no NAT, no IGW
IAM role on the caller list
per-session token, ends with the session
serves only the host that claimed it
the only egress the SG allows

1 ledger row written before the first invoke | 2 claim(nonce), then every op carries the nonce | 3 AgentCore routes by session id | a microVM re-booted behind a live id answers unclaimed and is stopped
